steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL DMEM with 50 mL FBS (10 % v/v), 5.6 mL 20 mM L‑glutamine (2 mM final), and 5.6 mL Penicillin‑Streptomycin 100× (1× final). Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine 2.5 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (50 mM), 4.6 g sucrose (270 mM), 5 mL 10 % Triton X‑100 (1 % v/v), 100 µL 0.5 M EDTA pH 8.0 (1 mM), 100 µL 0.5 M EGTA pH 8.0 (1 mM), 100 µL 1 M DTT (2 mM), one tablet protease‑inhibitor cocktail (1×), and add water to 42.2 mL. Use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Mix 50 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (50 mM), 10 mL 10 % Triton X‑100 (0.1 % v/v), 2 mL 1 M DTT (2 mM), and 938 mL water. Store at 4 °C, use within 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare salt wash buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Combine 50 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (50 mM), 10 mL 10 % Triton X‑100 (0.1 % v/v), 100 mL 5 M NaCl (0.5 M), 2 mL 1 M DTT (2 mM), and 838 mL water. Store at 4 °C, use within 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare reaction buffer (1 L)
steps.instruction: Mix 50 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 (50 mM), 2 mL 0.5 M EGTA pH 8.0 (1 mM), 2 mL 1 M DTT (2 mM), 10 mL 1 M MgAc (10 mM), and 937.6 mL water. Store at 4 °C, use within 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare radioactive ATP solution
steps.instruction: In a 150 µL tube combine 5–30 µL undiluted [γ‑32 P]ATP (3 000 Ci/mmol) with 15 µL 10 mM ATP (1 mM final) and 105–130 µL reaction buffer (recipe 5). Prepare immediately before use; calculate undiluted ATP volume to give ~500 cpm pmol⁻¹ ATP.

steps.title: Plate cells for transfection
steps.instruction: Detach two confluent 15 cm dishes of ALPK1‑KO HEK‑Blue cells with 3 mL trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 2–3 min, add 15 mL culture media, pipette to single‑cell suspension, combine into a 50 mL tube, count cells (ensure ≥90 % viability), and plate 15 × 10⁶ cells in 20 mL media per dish (three dishes). Distribute cells evenly with a figure‑of‑8 motion and incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 18 h.

steps.title: Transfect cells with FLAG‑ALPK1 plasmids
steps.instruction: For each of the three dishes prepare in a 1.5 mL tube: 150 µL Lipofectamine 2000 + 600 µL OptiMEM (invert 5×). Separately dilute 60 µg plasmid (empty vector, FLAG‑ALPK1, or FLAG‑ALPK1[S277F]) in 600 µL OptiMEM (invert 5×). Add diluted Lipofectamine to diluted plasmid, invert 5×, incubate 10 min at RT, then add dropwise to the corresponding dish. After 4 h replace media with 15 mL fresh culture media (pipette slowly against plate side). Return dishes to incubator for a further 20 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells and prepare extracts (Day 3)
steps.instruction: 24 h post‑transfection, detach cells by pipetting up‑and‑down with a 15 mL serological pipette (no trypsin). Transfer to 15 mL tubes, centrifuge 800 × g, 5 min, RT. Wash twice with 15 mL room‑temperature PBS (no resuspension), aspirate completely, keep pellets on ice. Add 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer per pellet, homogenize, transfer to pre‑chilled 1.5 mL tubes, centrifuge 18 000 × g, 20 min, 4 °C. Collect supernatant (cell extract) on ice.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration (Bradford)
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of each extract, add 20 µL water (1:5 dilution). In triplicate add each diluted sample to a 96‑well plate with 5 µL of BSA standards (2.0, 1.0, 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.0625 mg/mL). Add 195 µL Bradford reagent, read absorbance at 595 nm, interpolate to obtain concentration, accounting for the 1:5 dilution.

steps.title: Normalize extracts to 2 mg/mL
steps.instruction: Dilute each extract with ice‑cold lysis buffer to reach 2 mg/mL protein. Keep samples on ice (4 °C) for downstream steps.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate FLAG‑ALPK1 for normalization
steps.instruction: Prepare 55 µL anti‑FLAG M2 resin slurry (50 % resin) in a 1.5 mL tube on ice (trim pipette tip). Centrifuge 2 000 × g, 1 min, 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash three times with 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer (invert 5× each wash). Resuspend final bead pellet in 945 µL ice‑cold lysis buffer. Aliquot 270 µL slurry into three 1.5 mL tubes (15 µL resin each). Add 100 µL extract (0.2 mg protein) to each tube, rotate 4 °C, 1 h. Wash beads three times with ice‑cold salt wash buffer, then twice with ice‑cold wash buffer. After final wash, aspirate completely (dry beads). Resuspend beads in 20 µL LDS 1× buffer containing 2.5 % 2‑mercaptoethanol (prepare by mixing 20 µL LDS 4×, 58 µL water, 2 µL 2‑ME). Heat 5 min at 75 °C, centrifuge 13 000 × g, 30 s, transfer supernatant to Spin‑X columns, centrifuge 13 000 × g, 30 s. Load 10 µL eluate plus 5 µL Precision Plus protein ladder onto a 4–12 % NuPAGE gel.

steps.title: SDS‑PAGE, stain, and quantify ALPK1 levels
steps.instruction: Run gel, stain 30 min with InstantBlue, destain 1 h in water (change water regularly). Image gel, quantify FLAG‑ALPK1 band intensity (e.g., Image Lab). Calculate dilution factor needed to equalize ALPK1 levels across samples; if intensities are equal (as in example), no further dilution is required.

steps.title: Aliquot and snap‑freeze extracts
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.5 mL aliquots of each normalized extract on ice (0.5 mg protein per aliquot). Typically 15 aliquots per 15 cm dish, sufficient for 150 kinase reactions. Snap‑freeze aliquots, store at –80 °C, use within 1 month and avoid refreezing.

steps.title: Determine linear‑range time course for WT ALPK1
steps.instruction: Thaw two WT aliquots on ice, combine. Prepare 15 µL anti‑FLAG resin per reaction: add 600 µL 50 % resin slurry to a 1.5 mL tube on ice, centrifuge 2 000 × g, 1 min, 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash three times with 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer. Resuspend dry resin in 1 mg WT lysate, rotate 4 °C, 1 h. Wash resin three times with ice‑cold salt wash buffer, twice with ice‑cold wash buffer, once with ice‑cold reaction buffer. Resuspend 300 µL packed resin in 350 µL ice‑cold reaction buffer. Aliquot 32.5 µL slurry into 18 separate 1.5 mL tubes (each tube now 15 µL resin + 17.5 µL reaction buffer). Add 2.5 µL 1 mg/mL GST‑TIFA (2.5 µg, 2.1 µM) to each tube except the no‑GST control (add reaction buffer instead). Add 2.5 µL reaction buffer or 2.5 µL 100 µM ADP‑heptose (in reaction buffer) as appropriate. At 20 s intervals add 2.5 µL radioactive ATP solution to each tube. Place tubes on a pre‑warmed thermomixer at 30 °C, 1 300 rpm. For 0‑min control, terminate before adding radioactive ATP. For 5, 10, 20, 30 min time points, terminate by adding 8.3 µL 4× LDS buffer with 10 % 2‑ME, heat 5 min at 75 °C, remove resin with Spin‑X columns. Analyze 16.7 µL supernatant by SDS‑PAGE (run until dye front just enters gel). Stain 1 h with InstantBlue, destain 24 h (water changes).

steps.title: Quantify radioactivity from time‑course gels
steps.instruction: Wash gel five times 5 min each in water, discard waste as radioactive. Transfer gel to A4 plastic pocket, dab dry, excise GST‑TIFA bands with a scalpel, place each piece in a 1.5 mL tube. Centrifuge 13 000 × g, 1 min, add scintillation fluid, count each sample 2 min in a scintillation counter. Also count triplicate 1 µL aliquots of the radioactive ATP solution to determine specific activity (cpm nmol⁻¹). Plot cpm versus time to identify linear range (example: 20 min chosen).

steps.title: Endpoint assays for mutants with nucleotide sugars
steps.instruction: Thaw aliquots of WT and S277F extracts on ice (enough for 10 reactions each). Prepare 0.6 mL anti‑FLAG resin slurry (10 % excess) in a 1.5 mL tube on ice, centrifuge 2 000 × g, 1 min, 4 °C, wash twice with 1 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer, resuspend 300 µL resin in 300 µL lysis buffer, add 300 µL slurry to each lysate, rotate 4 °C, 1 h. Wash three times with ice‑cold salt wash buffer, twice with ice‑cold wash buffer, once with ice‑cold reaction buffer. Resuspend each 150 µL packed resin in 175 µL ice‑cold reaction buffer. Aliquot 32.5 µL slurry into eight 1.5 mL tubes (each tube 15 µL resin + 17.5 µL reaction buffer). Add 2.5 µL 1 mg/mL GST‑TIFA to each tube, then add 2.5 µL reaction buffer (buffer control) or 2.5 µL 100 µM ADP‑heptose, 1 mM UDP‑mannose, or 1 mM ADP‑ribose (all in reaction buffer). Add 2.5 µL radioactive ATP solution (as above) at 20 s intervals. Incubate on thermomixer 30 °C, 1 300 rpm for the optimal timepoint determined previously (e.g., 20 min). Terminate reactions with 8.3 µL 4× LDS buffer containing 10 % 2‑ME, heat 5 min at 75 °C, remove resin via Spin‑X columns, analyze 16.7 µL supernatant by SDS‑PAGE, stain 1 h InstantBlue, destain 24 h water (change frequently). Quantify incorporated radioactivity as in the time‑course section.
